entries.2cfa9e7764ee9905: The company states that since its founding in 1962 it has specialized in dispatching design engineers, and that as a pioneer in the industry it has built trust and a track record. Its foundation is a system in which Learning Centers, which centrally manage training for new-graduate engineers, are located in Suita, Osaka Prefecture, and Kohoku-ku, Yokohama, and engineers are developed and deployed through a cycle of recruitment, training, sales and support.
